description: PINNED XFAIL on impl#1 (g-client-template-interpolation-lowering-needs-a-structural-emitter, carried): this case states the CORRECT behaviour. S437 round 5's client template lowering was reverted before landing because it silently miscompiled other templates; the structural fix is its own arc. S437 round 5 F2: a reactive value attribute written as a template literal reading a cell (`style=(`color: ${@c}`)`) is emitted and re-renders on change. Before the root fix the client emitter left `${@c}` raw, so the attribute was DROPPED (W-CG-VALUE-ATTR-UNLOWERABLE, a fail-closed workaround) and absent at runtime.
rationale: A `${@cell}` inside a template literal in logic context is a cell read; a reactive attribute re-evaluates when the cell changes.
